newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to reopen probe into GAN aid on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU set to reopen probe into GAN aid on Wednesday.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to start a new probe on Wednesday into France's additional measures to help loss-making insurance group Groupe des Assurances de Paris (GAN).
"The issue is on the Commission's agenda," a Commission official told Reuters on Monday. There were no other details.
The French government announced in February a rescue package of up to 20 billion francs ($3.5 billion) after the state-controlled company accumulated 35 billion francs of losses since 1992.

Only in September 1996, the Commission approved a state capital injection of 2.8 billion francs as part of a plan which included the sale of GAN's majority stake in bank Credit Industriel et Commercial (CIC) and the privatisation of the insurance group as of 1997. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841 ($ = 5.755 French Francs)
